question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is** "sled".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The word **"sled" **refers to a vehicle used for sliding over snow or ice, typically pulled by horses or dogs.
 
• The correct option fits the context of the blank and makes grammatical sense in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 2". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Smell: **refers to the sense of detecting odors.
 
• **Bark: **refers to the sound made by dogs or other animals.
 
• **Boat: **refers to a watercraft used for transportation on water.
